resources.string: Scroll Bouncer is told which app has just been opened. When it is one you have chosen, a little guy walks across the screen and sends you back to the home screen. It cannot read what is on your screen, and it has no access to the internet.
Turn Scroll Bouncer on or off
He needs your permission to see which app is open. In Accessibility settings, find Scroll Bouncer and turn it on.
If Android says it is a restricted setting: open App info, tap the three dots in the corner, choose Allow restricted settings, then try again.
